scientific_integrity: Analytical proof via exact resolvents and convolution log-concavity; symbolic and numerical checker included. Standard convolution theorem and state-space framework credited as prior knowledge.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification for a three-room, equal-volume, symmetric, constant-coefficient linear model; does not extend automatically to asymmetric ventilation or airflow changes due to cleaners. No independent validation.
title: A unique transient filtration-placement reversal with cumulative dominance in a three-room path
